blocks.text: October 14-18, 2026 | SMX Aura Convention Center, Taguig City Before form, color, texture, and volume, there is the line. For its 18th edition, ManilART presents Where the Line Begins, a celebration of the line as the fundamental language of visual art. This year celebrates the line as the first gesture that transforms thought into image, imagination into form, and ideas into visual reality. ManilART’26 runs from October 14 to 18, 2026, at the SMX Aura Convention Center in Taguig City, bringing together galleries, artists, collectors, cultural institutions, and creative communities for five days of exhibitions and special features across the […]...
